source: DBS Beerus 02 episode, from 300 s (stream copy, starts on a keyframe)
convention: frame n = first frame of new shot, 0-based decode order

hard_cuts.note: cut to a bright, hazy yellow shot (staff descending), not a flash: the Whis shot does not come back
first frame of the new shot is a blurred smear of Goku's hair; 956-996 is one shot (head turning to camera on 3s)
new shot starts very dark (Beerus' back close-up), camera then pulls back through the door
cut from the Kamehameha whiteout (1872-1876) to the beam over the house
cut to a smoke close-up that clears to reveal King Kai (same shot until 2742)
followed by a slow tilt up on Beerus until the end

ambiguous.why: Frieza knocked away past the camera: extreme close-up of his back (1223-1224) jumps to a wide view of him from behind (1225), same sky; most likely one shot with him flying away from the lens, but it could be a cut
stepped push-in on Goku charging the Kamehameha: the framing jumps at 1814, 1817, 1820, 1823, 1826, 1829 (3-frame holds, same background) while he turns; treated as one shot, not cuts
stepped zoom-in on Goku turning around (2-frame holds at 1997, 1999, 2001, 2003, 2005, 2007, 2009, same background and beam); 1996->1997 also changes his pose; treated as one shot, not cuts

notable_non_cuts: 401-412 Beerus moves in the bath (same shot); 595-630 Beerus rises from the water with a stepped camera move; 866-899 tilt up on the beam of light; 900-910 Goku's image fades in INSIDE the beam (a projection superimposed on the same shot, not a transition); 957-981 Goku's head turns to camera on 3s with a push-in (big jumps at 957, 960, 969, 972, 975, 978, 981); 997-1070 tilt up from Goku's belt to his face; 1218-1222 and 1232-1236 punch flashes/auras in the Frieza flashback; 1685-1768 slow pull-back on Goku's face; 1769-1771 Goku's hands sweep into the lens then the camera pulls back (1772-1801); 1802 Goku swings his hands to his side (pose change, same background); 1864-1876 the Kamehameha ball grows to a full whiteout (no cut until 1877); 1938-1960 camera follows the beam; 2187-2210 explosion grows to fill the frame with smoke; 2535-2540 shockwave/dust rushing at the camera, the same wide shot comes back at 2541; 2548-2575 wind gusts; 2636-2645 smoke clears; 2933-2939 King Kai's arm passes in front of the camera; 3050-3090 and 3280-3286 King Kai turning/moving with small reframes; 3388-3421 pan/tilt up to the tree; 3422-3637 tilt up on Beerus.
